newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver erases some losses but ends down.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver erases some losses but ends down.

text.p: Indian silver erased some early losses on Friday on the back of industrial and seasonal buying but a weak global trend kept prices lower, dealers said.
Silver was down by 5 rupees per kg on Thursday.
"Arrivals of imported silver continued and sentiment remained subdued at the close of the session," one dealer said.
Gold opened on a quiet note but slid towards close on fresh arrivals. Gold was down by 30 rupees per 10 gramme on Thursday.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 50 rupees lower at 59,800 rupees per piece.
Gold biscuits were down by 350 rupees on Thursday.
